steps.code:
# Fetch all recommendation pages (page_limit=20) until we get fewer than 20 songs.
access_token = "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJzcG90aWZ5K2thX2J1cnRAZ21haWwuY29tIiwiZXhwIjoxNjg0NDEyNzQxfQ.bOzTpsLJpCWJvAUd6RUezYTwqojzqw5JPt7HxpQvHeQ"
all_recs = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_recommendations(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    all_recs.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1
print("Total recommendations:", len(all_recs))
print("First few song_ids:", [r["song_id"] for r in all_recs[:5]])
